subject: AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF
text:
U1421/26 NOTAMR U0922/26 
Q)UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03716E999 
A)UUUU B)2610190656 C)2701192359 EST E) AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF 
MONTENEGRO STIPULATING THAT ALL AIRCRAFT REGISTERED IN RUSSIAN 
FEDERATION, OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL 
PERSONS FROM RUSSIAN FEDERATION AND OPERATORS HOLDING OPERATORS 
LICENSE (OL) OR ITS EQUIVALENT, ISSUED BY RUSSIAN FEDERATION 
AUTHORITIES, ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY AIRSPACE OF 
MONTENEGRO AS PART OF BEOGRAD FIR, EXCEPT FOR HUM FLT, SAR FLT AND 
LEASED ACFT ONE-WAY RETURN FLT UPON PERMISSION BY AUTHORITIES OF 
MONTENEGRO, AS WELL AS IN CASES OF EMERGENCY LANDING OR OVERFLIGHT, 
AS PER AIP SUP 2/23, AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION 
HEREBY INFORM THAT ALL ACFT REGISTERED IN MONTENEGRO AND ALL ACFT 
OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSONS FROM 
MONTENEGRO, OR OPERATORS HOLDING AOC ISSUED BY AUTHORITIES OF 
MONTENEGRO ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY AIRSPACE OF 
RUSSIAN FEDERATION, EXCEPT FOR ACFT IN EMERGENCY, HUM FLT, SAN FLT, AS WELL AS IN CASES 
WHEN SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR FLT OPS GRANTED BY FEDERAL AIR 
TRANSPORT AGENCY OR MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF RUSSIAN 
FEDERATION, AS APPROPRIATE.
